value.rationale: The first integer-lattice obstruction to a new rational Chern-filtration theorem, including its disappearance at the next width after a length-three obstruction window, is an intrinsic cohomological index and motivates the exact finite cutoff. The result distinguishes integral from rational generation and is not a reparameterized individual Kostka value.
